title: Snail dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='34' ry='5' fill='#2a3a5a' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- stretched foot/body -->
  <path d='M14 82 Q10 76 16 72 L82 70 Q92 72 88 80 Q84 86 76 84 L24 86 Q16 87 14 82 Z' fill='#7ecf6e'/>
  <path d='M16 72 Q24 66 32 70 L54 72 L30 76 Q20 78 16 72 Z' fill='#9ae889'/>
  <!-- foot ripples -->
  <path d='M24 84 Q30 82 36 84' stroke='#5ab84a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 83 Q58 81 64 83' stroke='#5ab84a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 82 Q77 80 82 82' stroke='#5ab84a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- tail wave -->
  <path d='M14 82 Q6 76 10 68 Q14 62 20 66' fill='#7ecf6e'/>
  <path d='M10 68 Q14 64 18 67' stroke='#9ae889' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- shell -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='48' r='28' fill='#f5a623'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='48' r='27' fill='none' stroke='#ffcf66' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- shell spiral -->
  <path d='M52 48 m0 -18 a18 18 0 1 1 -18 18 a14 14 0 1 1 14 14 a10 10 0 1 1 10 -10 a6 6 0 1 1 -6 6' fill='none' stroke='#c47a10' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- shell shine -->
  <path d='M40 32 Q44 28 50 28' stroke='#ffe28a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- neck and head -->
  <path d='M74 66 Q82 56 82 48 Q82 36 74 36 Q66 36 66 46' fill='#7ecf6e'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='38' r='11' fill='#7ecf6e'/>
  <!-- head shine -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='32' r='3' fill='#9ae889'/>

  <!-- eye stalks -->
  <path d='M70 30 Q66 20 64 14' stroke='#7ecf6e' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M82 30 Q86 20 88 14' stroke='#7ecf6e' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='13' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='13' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='13' r='2' fill='#2a3a5a'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='13' r='2' fill='#2a3a5a'/>
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='63' cy='12' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='87' cy='12' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M70 42 Q76 48 82 42' stroke='#2a6a2a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='40' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff9a9a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='83' cy='40' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff9a9a' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- dancing arms/motion lines -->
  <path d='M40 66 Q36 56 30 54' stroke='#7ecf6e' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='53' r='3' fill='#7ecf6e'/>
  <path d='M60 64 Q64 54 70 52' stroke='#7ecf6e' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='51' r='3' fill='#7ecf6e'/>

  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill='#ff6b9d'>
    <circle cx='22' cy='30' r='3.5'/>
    <rect x='24.5' y='18' width='2' height='12'/>
    <path d='M26.5 18 Q32 16 32 22' stroke='#ff6b9d' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ffd93d'>
    <circle cx='90' cy='38' r='3'/>
    <rect x='92' y='27' width='1.8' height='11'/>
    <path d='M93.8 27 Q98 25 98 30' stroke='#ffd93d' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#6bcbff'>
    <circle cx='84' cy='68' r='2.8'/>
    <rect x='86' y='58' width='1.6' height='10'/>
  </g>
</svg>
